competitiveTarget: Beat generic national-brokerage profile pages by leading with honesty, verified facts, real broker names + licenses, and zero marketing-speak (CLAUDE.md Data Accuracy + brand voice).
note: Wave 3 site-v2 rebuild, selective-fidelity uplift 2026-06-02. SiteHeader/SiteFooter render from app/layout.tsx. Every claim is verified: Ryan Realty LLC license 201253677 (founded 2023-06-21 OREA), Matt PB 201206613, brokers from getBrokers(), CityGrid counts live from geo_snapshot_mv. Added the mockup's heritage strip, Jax mascot, and 'where we work' city grid; the big-CTA is the two-card CtaDuo (replaces the prior navy CTABar). Deliberate divergences from the mockup, all per CLAUDE.md §0 Data Accuracy: (1) the mockup's '37 deals closed / 6 listings turned down' story stat is unverifiable and is NOT rendered; (2) the Jax bio (the dog's age, breed color, 'every closing dinner', office street) is unverified and is omitted — JaxStory states only brand-canonical facts; (3) the heritage ribbon's 'It's About Relationships' hits the banned-word gate ('about'), so HeritageStrip uses a verified factual descriptor; (4) the city grid renders live geo_snapshot_mv counts, not the mockup's hardcoded '612 active' placeholders. Team grid + FAQ are verified-fact additions retained beyond the mockup (the mockup is a floor, not a cap). NO testimonials are rendered: no verified client-review source is wired (fabricated reviews are a compliance + Data Accuracy violation). TestimonialBlock stays deferred until a real GBP-review source is connected.
